source_audit_support.source_locator: SPP Document 208, Section 8 Jury composition and duties

proposed.explanation: SPP 208 specifies the Jury: maximum 7 members, must be an odd number, and majority must be RLAs. For a 7-member Jury, at least 4 must be RLAs. The odd-number requirement prevents tie votes in deliberations.
